sources.use: Godot 4.7 performance guidance; measurement before optimization
Node/Server tradeoffs; server interaction may cause stalls
MultiMesh GPU instancing and per-instance culling limitation
Fixed ticks separated from rendering, interpolation
Structural contracts are distinct from semantic graphs
Stateful property-based testing; future optional tool
Graph/economy and level PCG; does not validate survivor-like fun
Automated game testing survey; generalization/explainability limits
Tool-using LLM-based PCG, open-ended directives; no proof for our engine
Systematic review and meta-analysis of immersion factors
Review of DDA in serious games; limited direct transfer
Independent acceptance must detect invalid tests/tasks
Targeted agent context can help; provider-produced comparison not universal
Real repo verifier, anti-reward-hacking and end-to-end scoring

gates.capability: Canonical fixed tick, stable IDs, phase ordering and independent named RNG streams
gates.acceptance: Two identical seed/input logs yield the same ordered event+build digest; distinguish cross-OS float divergence and inspect it
gates.anti_goal: Do not require global bit-identical GPU visuals or a networking rollback framework

gates.capability: Versioned canonical definitions, schema + semantic registry, immutable RunRulesHash and migration policy
gates.acceptance: Reject schema mismatch, missing references and unversioned semantic change; model migration golden fixtures
gates.anti_goal: Do not replace semantic validators with JSON Schema alone

gates.capability: Effect provenance, source lifetime, snapshot stage, finite/provable event bounds and policy-specific performance profile
gates.acceptance: Reject unbounded cycles, preserve logical hit results, profile logical work separately from VFX
gates.anti_goal: Do not globally clamp proc count, Multicast or slot count to hide performance problems

gates.capability: Exactly-once pickup source/value, reward arbitration and safe choice queue with accessibility modes
gates.acceptance: Value and IDs survive consolidation, replay, pause and multi-level receipts; stale offers reject atomically
gates.anti_goal: Do not grant XP from UI sprites or merge nonadditive reward kinds

gates.capability: Metamorphic/fuzz/state-transition tests with deterministic seed corpus and negative-control mutations
gates.acceptance: CI confirms same-seed reproducibility, safe permutation invariance and deliberate invalid fixtures failing
gates.anti_goal: Do not treat a single curated happy-path witness as proof of every possible build

gates.capability: Explicit acquisition, recipe reachability, slot deltas, catalysts and evolution source gates
gates.acceptance: For each authored evolution obtain positive witness or explain unreachability by policy; keep unusual high-power paths
gates.anti_goal: Do not impose universal six slots, one copy, exactly five ranks or forbid finite proc cycles

gates.capability: Hybrid model: logical stores for dense enemies/pickups, authored scenes for unique objects, spatial queries via grid when warranted
gates.acceptance: Record CPU/render targets and independent costs, prove world-logic invariants before choosing Server/MultiMesh
gates.anti_goal: Do not force full ECS, GPU simulation, multithreaded Godot scenes or immediate GDExtension

gates.capability: Per-profile workload instrumentation: casts, hits, active effects, pickup queries, VFX/audio, frame/tick CPU
gates.acceptance: Measure p50/p95/p99 CPU+GPU, memory and worst scenario once runtime exists; preserve game semantics
gates.anti_goal: Do not promise FPS from static proc-event bound or render every logical hit

gates.capability: ChoiceViewModel from canonical data, explicit input focus contract and warning-layer priority
gates.acceptance: Cards explain owned tags, rank delta, recipe costs and source; no carried button press can confirm
gates.anti_goal: Do not silently auto-pick exclusive meridian/ritual or let cosmetic VFX hide boss tells

gates.capability: Deterministic persona/scenario bots with multi-objective metrics; independent human UX tests
gates.acceptance: Collect build viability, threats, XP/min, warning failures and comfort; human studies validate enjoyment
gates.anti_goal: Do not optimize only DPS or claim agent playtesting proves player fun

gates.capability: Small scoped tasks with impact graph, canary-failing negative fixtures, independent verify and CI-first merge
gates.acceptance: Each material architecture change has matching source map, acceptance trace and reject-on-mutation control
gates.anti_goal: Do not measure success by number of green tests alone or model benchmark rank

gates.capability: Optional PCG/RL/LLM-assisted encounter or level candidates with declarative constraints
gates.acceptance: Generated candidate must pass topology, reward, reachability, danger and human review gates
gates.anti_goal: Do not generate autonomous balance by optimizing a proxy metric without measured player outcomes

gates.capability: Versioned immutable run snapshot with replay checkpoint, RNG streams, choice queue and atomic meta settlement
gates.acceptance: Pause/resume and reopen cannot duplicate reward or silently change RulesHash; migration tests preserve semantics
gates.anti_goal: Do not build generalized distributed event store or network sync for offline solo game

gates.capability: Measure agency/interruptions/recognizability and accessible input with keyboard+controller playtests
gates.acceptance: A/B compares immediate vs banked with consent and declared cohorts, not cherry-picked session traces
gates.anti_goal: Do not invent retention or universal UI reaction-time thresholds

gates.capability: Optional GDExtension/C++ / ECS / multithreading only after isolated CPU hotspot and benchmark
gates.acceptance: Same golden simulation outcomes, cross-OS CI and measurable speedup without authoring regressions
gates.anti_goal: Do not choose a native rewrite or networked co-op because it is fashionable
